query_smt2:
(set-logic QF_BV)
(declare-fun expr_capacity () (_ BitVec 8))
(declare-fun expr_length () (_ BitVec 8))
(declare-fun expr_offset () (_ BitVec 8))
(assert (= expr_offset #xff))
(assert (= expr_length #x01))
(assert (= expr_capacity #x00))
(assert (not (bvule (bvadd ((_ zero_extend 1) expr_offset) ((_ zero_extend 1) expr_length)) ((_ zero_extend 1) expr_capacity))))
(check-sat)
